title: In memory of the man who put red and green squiggles under words
summary: A memorial tribute to the Microsoft engineer who implemented the red and green wavy underlines for spell-checking and grammar checking in Microsoft Word, one of the most universally used features in software history that has helped billions of users catch writing errors.
problem_solved: Made spelling and grammar errors immediately visible to users while typing, revolutionizing how people write and edit documents.
why_valuable: This feature became a ubiquitous standard in word processing software, fundamentally improving writing quality for virtually every computer user worldwide.
